name: element.find
description: Locate a UI element by accessibility role / name / automation id, optionally rooted at a window. Returns the matched element's accessible properties and bounds. Read-only.

root.description: Optional window handle to scope the search. If omitted, searches the desktop root.

name.description: Accessible name to match (UIA Name / AX kAXTitle).

automation_id.description: Stable automation identifier (UIA AutomationId, AX kAXIdentifier).

timeout_ms.description: Time to keep retrying before returning ERR not_found.

windows-modern.description: IUIAutomation::FindFirst with TreeScope_Subtree from the supplied root or RootElement. ERR uia_blind when the target lives across an integrity-level boundary the agent cannot cross.

windows-classic.reason: UIA does not exist pre-Vista. system.info.capabilities.ui_automation: no. The compiler/generator excludes this verb from windows-classic VERBS.md output.
